description:
New module `Filament.Web.RenderToRendered` (working name; final location pending Phase 4 namespace decision). Takes a vnode tree + fiber tree and produces `%Phoenix.LiveView.Rendered{}` that PLV's diff engine accepts.

## Owns

- HTML escape and serialization for `:element` nodes.
- Void-element handling (br, hr, img, input, etc.).
- `:component` node translation into PLV's keyed-comprehension shape — `%Phoenix.LiveView.Comprehension{has_key?: true, entries: [{key, var_map, entry_fn}]}` with the keyed-reordering wire format intact.
- `phx-event="filament:..."` attribute rewriting from event-handler tuples.
- Fingerprinting per static template for diff efficiency.

This is essentially extracting the Phoenix-specific bits of today's `~F` codegen target into a runtime function. The compiler (1.3) will emit vnode trees; this converter does the work the compiler used to do at compile time.

## Files

- New `lib/filament/web/render_to_rendered.ex` (path provisional).
- New `test/filament/web/render_to_rendered_test.exs`.

## Acceptance

- `Filament.Web.RenderToRendered.convert(vnode_tree, fiber_tree, opts) :: %Phoenix.LiveView.Rendered{}`.
- Output passes PLV's diff engine without crashes for every vnode shape.
- Wire format byte-compatible (or smaller) for representative cases — verify by mounting the todo example and inspecting WebSocket frames the way we did for the keyed-comprehension fix.
- Keyed comprehensions still emit `"k"`/`"kc"` structure with stable per-item fingerprints across re-renders.
title: Phase 1.3: Filament.Web vnode-to-Rendered converter
